tei:div.tei:p: 139)༄༅/ chos sku kun bzang longs sku rdo rje sems// sprul sku dga' rab 'jam dpal shrū seng*// dzñā na sū tra bi ma padma 'byung*// klong chen rab 'byams kun bzang shes rab sogs// 'od gsal rdzogs chen brgyud pa rin po che/ khyad par mnyam med 'gro ba'i mgon po ni// klong chen 'od gsal nam mkha'i rdo rje dang*// rig pa 'dzin pa dpal chen 'dus pa sogs// snga 'gyur rig 'dzin brgyud par gsol ba 'debs// dal 'byor don ldan 'chi ba snying nas dran// las 'bras yid ches 'khor bar snying nas skrag /skyabs gsum yid ches byang chub sems mchog 'byongs// 'gal skyen sgrib sbyangs mthun rkyen tshogs gnyis rdzogs// bla ma sangs rgyas dngos mthong mos gus kyis// cir snang dag pa rab 'byams lha skur 'char// ma dag rtsa rlung dag pa ye shes rtsal// dpyid thig 140)'pho med 'od gsal dbyings su zlum/ khregs chod stong pa'i 'od gsal yongs su gyur// thod rgal snang ba'i 'od gsal mtha' ru phyin// gdeng bzhi'i grol tshad tshe 'dir mngon byang chub// 'chi ba'i bar do rang snang longs spyod rdzogs// srid pa bar do rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing*// bgrod nas rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub shog
ces pa'ang smar shod chu lding bla ma dam pa blo gros rgya mtsho'i ngor padma ma ṇis bris pa dge legs 'phel// bkra shis//
